profile.headline: Software/Full-Stack/UI/UX/Web Developer
profile.summary: Prolific, jack of all trades full-stack developer with 10+ years experience in application, full-stack, and frontend development. Passionate of building the best web application and creating reusable components and design to improve site building time and keep consistency in code and design.   Keeping up with new technologies and tools to help build UI/UX elements and bring ideas to life.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Full stack web developer responsible for end-to-end web app development.
Design and develop web services components for cross-application solutions
Interact with system designers and provide feedback on design modules
Perform testing on developed code (initial and regression)
Coordinate and prioritize application modifications and bug fixes
Participate and contribute to a team approach to software development and problem-solving using Agile/Scrum practices
Accept and provide feedback on all work efforts, and proactively engage with internal and external team members to achieve optimal solutions
Debug and rapidly resolve issues.
Provide expert consultation to clients in effectively resolving issues and addressing their inquiries with utmost professionalism and efficiency.
Conducting thorough operation and maintenance procedures on the website, ensuring seamless functionality and optimal performance at all times.
Staying current on emerging technologies and leveraging the latest build tools to enhance the company's technological capabilities and gain a competitive edge in the industry.
Developing documentation to serve as a valuable reference for clients and internal stakeholders, facilitating smooth and efficient operations.
Work on Internal Design Systems using tools like storybook, figma
Create React/Web Components for internal design system
Maintain and Develop Drupal Sites (v. 7-10)

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Engage with the solutions architect, development team, management, business analysts, designers, project teams, and others to develop world-class solutions
Develop and support internet and intranet applications developed with Drupal 8 CMS and related modules, PHP, and other related technologies
Develop and execute unit tests for all work output
Implement sites from HTML markup or Photoshop designs
Assist web designers with front-end development, including markup, CSS styles, and JavaScript
Take responsibility for establishing and reporting progress on project goals and work within established project methodologies and within deadlines
Mentor other developers and provide leadership on technologies and methodologies
Accept and provide feedback on all work efforts, and proactively engage with internal and external team members to achieve optimal solutions

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Plan and develop new software
• Develop web applications using PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS, and MySQL in a Linux Environment.
• Maintain, enhance and periodically re-design the 40+ websites operated by Michael J. Hennessy Associates in order to increase pageviews and web-traffic. Site redesigns have recently more than doubled web-traffic, leading to improved ad revenue. 
• Engage in ongoing re-development of in-house software systems with an eye towards improving functionality, reliability, system performance, speed, and quality, and reduce costs.
• Collaborate with a team of developers and content editors to design, test, release and support new features.
• Problem solve and implement plans to improve UX and satisfying clients and stakeholders 
•  Implement new technologies
• Create client animated Ad banner following Google standards
• Create client website

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Execute all visual design stages of website layouts from wireframing to PSD mock-ups
- Create compelling websites based on your designs
- Envision original ideas and bring simplicity targeted on UX
- Exploit existing systems and make suggestions for improvement
- Work collaboratively to implement projects
- Participate in client meetings to ensure design and brand consistency
- Create custom logo designs and adhere to brand guidelines
- Create static and motion graphics for social media, email, and online campaigns
- Workload is approximately 30% design and 70% front-end development

positions.title: Media Director / Graphic Designer / Admin
positions.description:
Shoot and Edit Videos
Create Graphics
Create Printable Materials
Maintain Website
Send out emails using HTML

positions.title: Web Developer / Video Editor
positions.description:
Maintain the company's website and created websites for events using CMS such as Wordpress and Drupal.
Made sure that the UX and UI was compatible for large format screen to mobile.
Coded in HTML, CSS, JAVASCRIPT for the frontend and also modify plugins in the backend when needed.
Maintain weekly backups of the databases for the websites.

positions.title: Drupal Developer and Web Developer
positions.description:
Implemented code for their website that made it mobile friendly and as well as desktop friendly
Program their website with HTML, CSS, & JAVASCRIPT and made it cross-compatible to all browsers (Firefox, Safari, Chrome, Internet Explorer), including mobile devices. 
Program & Maintain clients websites (Horizon, Rayant, and Jackson Hewitt)
Create HTML emails for clients newsletters.

positions.title: Assistant to the Media Director
positions.description:
Maintain the company's website and created websites for events using CMS such as Wordpress and Drupal.
Made sure that the UX and UI was compatible for large format screen to mobile.
Coded in HTML, CSS, JAVASCRIPT for the frontend and also modify plugins in the backend when needed.
Maintain weekly backups of the databases for the websites.
Maintain and Create new designs to keep up with trends for the websites
Videographer and Video Editor, Creating video promos for events and recaps of the events. Record interviews; take additional footage as well as photos of events.
Production Director for events.  In charge of the production of live large events
